summary: Signet Jewelers filed an 8-K reporting that on September 4, 2026, through subsidiaries Sterling and Zale, it entered a Second Amended and Restated Credit Card Program Agreement with Bread Financial's Comenity Bank and Comenity Capital Bank, consolidating prior 2021 private-label card pacts. The program runs through December 31, 2035, with successive two-year renewals by mutual agreement, includes a signing bonus potentially repayable on termination, and a profit-share component. Bread becomes exclusive US issuer of Signet-branded open-ended credit. Signet retains an option to purchase program assets at the greater of fair market value or par upon expiry. This is a routine commercial credit-card contract, not a special situation; key monitorable is renewal/termination economics.
